pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Nexus is an offline-first desktop workspace: tasks, calendar, notes, documents, study, habits, fitness and finance in one encrypted local database. Everything is stored on the device in SQLCipher- encrypted SQLite; cloud sync is opt-in and end-to-end encrypted, and a build that has never had it enabled makes no network calls at all.
This package installs the prebuilt x86_64 Electron bundle — portage does not rebuild Chromium from the application source.
